special_cases.source_basis: SI Note 2 gives a 107 mm ring bore and 102 mm tube OD and calls the tube a cover support; the load-bearing attachment is not described
special_cases.selected: Reconstruct the lower film as a tensioned membrane contacting the PE tube rim and supporting the outer spacer; keep the ring in its loading jig until stability, attachment and sag are qualified
special_cases.physical_rationale: The ring cannot bear directly on a smaller-diameter tube, but the film spans both tube and ring; this supplies a possible continuous load path without silently adding a conductive bracket
special_cases.confidence: Low; a physical reconstruction hypothesis, not established historical mounting or verified load capacity
special_cases.alternative: A disclosed peripheral retaining fixture, with its extra contact and heat-transfer path included in the geometry and analysis
special_cases.validation: Measure the actual ring load, film sag/creep, attachment strength and emitter gap using the installed material; if criteria fail, keep support retained and revise the design. The flat visual film is an unloaded approximation, not a support simulation

special_cases.selected: Direct component measurement when compatible; otherwise matched-batch witnesses with explicit size and layer-spacing inputs
special_cases.alternative: Custom holder accommodating the actual component
special_cases.validation: Verify accessory aperture, coating/film equivalence and source interpretation; no historical serial reuse claim

special_cases.selected: Use the text's nominal 150 mm emitter-to-reflector height for the reconstruction; retain the SI 100 mm dimension as unresolved
special_cases.alternative: Reconstruct the schematic version after its datum is established
special_cases.validation: Compare against source drawings and finite-aperture shadow geometry

special_cases.selected: Two additional insulation points near the axis and four PE/shield/aperture contacts have explicit approximate coordinates in sensor_installation.json
special_cases.validation: SI Figure5 p6 re-inspected October17; two insulation locations require explicit recess/layer-interface handling. Positions, azimuth, attachment and changed heat paths remain inferred

special_cases.selected: Install a K-compatible transition from the 36 AWG stripped probe to terminal-compatible extension conductors, with independent strain relief; calibrate the complete path
special_cases.rationale: The manufacturer's 16-30 AWG terminal range does not cover the source's 36 AWG probe wire
special_cases.alternative: A separately qualified fine-wire clamp/termination with documented thermoelectric behavior
special_cases.validation: Select actual transition hardware, prove retention and polarity, inspect introduced junctions and include the complete connection in calibration. No historical adapter is asserted
